immersiveFeed.label: Immersive feed, one post per screen
immersiveFeed.keyboardHint: Up and down arrows, or Page Up and Page Down: previous or next post. A post taller than the screen scrolls first.
immersiveFeed.end: You have seen all the available posts in this feed.
immersiveFeed.emptyWindow: No posts in this part of the feed. The next part may contain some.
immersiveFeed.newPostsShown: Back to the most recent posts.
immersiveFeed.removed: This post is no longer available. Reading continues with the next one.
immersiveFeed.restoring: The feed was refreshed. Returning to the post you were reading…
immersiveFeed.restored: Back to the post you were reading.
immersiveFeed.restoreMissing: The post you were reading is no longer in this feed.

feedMode.lowHeight: The screen is too short for the immersive view: the feed stays as a list. The immersive view comes back as soon as the height allows it.

suspended.hidden: Playback paused while you were away.
